hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */client/web/*.ts|*/client/web/*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; bin="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/client/web/node_modules/.bin/oxlint"; [ -x "$bin" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/client/web" && "$bin" "$f" >&2 || exit 2; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */okf/*.md) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; python3 -I "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/okf-validate.py" >&2 || exit 2; }
